academicResearch.name: General Academic Research
academicResearch.description: Suitable for general academic research, including six standard modules: research background, literature review, research methods, core concepts, application domains, and future directions

research_background.title: Research Background
research_background.description: Background information, development history, and current status of the research topic
research_background.relationshipToCore: Provides the foundation and motivation for the research

literature_review.title: Literature Review
literature_review.description: Review and analysis of related literature
literature_review.relationshipToCore: Establishes the theoretical foundation and research context

research_methods.title: Research Methods
research_methods.description: Methodology and technical approaches used in the research
research_methods.relationshipToCore: Provides the implementation path for the research

core_concepts.title: Core Concepts
core_concepts.description: Core concepts, definitions, and theoretical framework of the research
core_concepts.relationshipToCore: The core content and contribution of the research

application_domains.title: Application Domains
application_domains.description: Application domains and practical scenarios of research outcomes
application_domains.relationshipToCore: Demonstrates the practical value of the research

future_directions.title: Future Directions
future_directions.description: Future research directions and development trends

experimentalScience.name: Experimental Science Research
experimentalScience.description: Suitable for experimental science, including six modules: research background, literature review, experiment design, data collection, result analysis, and application domains

research_background.title: Research Background
research_background.description: Background information, development history, and research motivation of the research topic
research_background.relationshipToCore: Provides the foundation and motivation for the research

literature_review.title: Literature Review
literature_review.description: Review and theoretical foundation of related literature
literature_review.relationshipToCore: Establishes the theoretical foundation and research context

experiment_design.title: Experiment Design
experiment_design.description: Experimental scheme design and implementation process
experiment_design.relationshipToCore: Ensures the reliability and validity of the experiment

data_collection.title: Data Collection
data_collection.description: Data collection methods and data processing workflow

result_analysis.title: Result Analysis
result_analysis.description: Experimental result analysis and conclusion derivation

application_domains.title: Application Domains
application_domains.description: Application prospects and practical scenarios of research outcomes
application_domains.relationshipToCore: Demonstrates the practical value of the research

engineeringResearch.name: Engineering and Technical Research
engineeringResearch.description: Suitable for engineering and technical research, including six modules: problem background, technical architecture, engineering implementation, performance evaluation, application cases, and future directions

problem_background.title: Problem Background
problem_background.description: Background and requirements analysis of the engineering problem

tech_architecture.title: Technical Architecture
tech_architecture.description: Technical architecture design scheme of the system
tech_architecture.relationshipToCore: Provides the overall blueprint of the system

engineering_implementation.title: Engineering Implementation
engineering_implementation.description: Specific engineering implementation scheme and technical details
engineering_implementation.relationshipToCore: Transforms design into a running system

performance_evaluation.title: Performance Evaluation
performance_evaluation.description: System performance testing and evaluation results
performance_evaluation.relationshipToCore: Verifies whether the system meets expected goals

application_cases.title: Application Cases
application_cases.description: Application cases of the system in real scenarios
application_cases.relationshipToCore: Demonstrates the practical application value of the system

future_directions.title: Future Directions
future_directions.description: Future optimization directions and development plans
future_directions.relationshipToCore: Points out the follow-up development direction of the system

policyResearch.name: Policy Research
policyResearch.description: Suitable for policy research, including six modules: policy background, policy instruments, implementation mechanism, impact evaluation, case studies, and policy recommendations

policy_background.title: Policy Background
policy_background.description: Background, historical evolution, and policy environment of the policy
policy_background.relationshipToCore: Understands the broader context of policy making

policy_instruments.title: Policy Instruments
policy_instruments.description: Tools and means adopted by the policy
policy_instruments.relationshipToCore: Clarifies the specific means of policy implementation

implementation_mechanism.title: Implementation Mechanism
implementation_mechanism.description: Execution mechanism and implementation approach of the policy
implementation_mechanism.relationshipToCore: Ensures the policy can be effectively implemented

impact_evaluation.title: Impact Evaluation
impact_evaluation.description: Evaluation of the effects and impacts of policy implementation
impact_evaluation.relationshipToCore: Measures the actual effects of the policy

case_studies.title: Case Studies
case_studies.description: Analysis of related domestic and international policy cases
case_studies.relationshipToCore: Provides practical reference and experience for reference

policy_recommendations.title: Policy Recommendations
policy_recommendations.description: Policy recommendations and optimization directions based on the research
